A1.label: Passport (biographical data page)
A1.note: Strongest option. The machine readable zone carries date of birth in a fixed format.

A1.label: National identity card
A1.note: Layout is issuer specific; profile extraction per issuing country.

A1.label: Driving licence
A1.note: Separate issuer and layout from the national ID; do not group the two.

A1.label: Birth certificate
A1.note: Authoritative for date of birth but carries no photograph, so the name check matters more.

A1.label: Certificate of naturalisation or citizenship
A1.note: Carries date of birth and also satisfies the citizenship question.

A1.label: School leaving or matriculation certificate
A1.note: Common fallback for applicants whose birth was registered late or not at all.

A1.label: Residence or work permit
A1.note: For applicants who are not citizens.

A1.label: Sworn affidavit before a commissioner of oaths
A1.note: Last resort where no civil record exists. Should always route to a human reviewer.
A1.display: sworn affidavit before a commissioner of oaths
A1.review_required: A sworn affidavit is last-resort evidence, used where no civil record exists, and always goes to a person.

A1.label: Other — please specify
A1.note: Free text. Treat as unprofiled: extraction is generic and confidence should be lower.

A4.label: Certificate of naturalisation
A4.note: The only document that directly evidences naturalised status.

A4.label: Other — please specify
A4.note: Free text. Used where the applicant evidences citizenship by another means.

Q1.label: Degree or diploma certificate
Q1.note: Primary route. Should carry an award confirmation and, ideally, a full transcript.

Q1.label: Professional body membership certificate
Q1.note: For designations such as CA, CFA, ACCA, CIMA. Membership status can lapse, so check currency, not just historical admission.

Q1.label: Academic transcript only
Q1.note: Confirms coursework but not always that the award was conferred; weaker than a degree certificate on its own.

Q3.label: Certificate of service or employment letter
Q3.note: Primary route. Should state total continuous service and a full position history.
Q3.display: certificate of service or employment letter

Q3.label: Reference letter from a former employer
Q3.note: Weaker than a certificate of service, since it is not always issued by human resources.
Q3.display: reference letter from a former employer

Q3.label: Employment contract
Q3.note: Confirms a start date and role but not a leaving date or total tenure.

PC1.label: Police clearance certificate
PC1.note: Primary route. Must state the categories of record and the period searched, or Scope_Check cannot be performed.

PC1.label: Certificate of good conduct
PC1.note: Naming convention used in some jurisdictions for the same instrument as a police clearance.

PC1.label: Court record extract
PC1.note: Used to confirm the particulars of a specific matter already disclosed, not as a first search.
PC1.insufficient_alone: A court record extract confirms the particulars of one matter already disclosed; it is not a search of the records, so on its own it cannot show there is no other.

PC19.label: Tax compliance certificate with historical statement
PC19.note: Primary route, but only if it states the position over time. A bare current-status certificate cannot answer this question — see Period_Coverage_Check.
PC19.display: tax compliance certificate with historical statement

PC19.label: Tax clearance certificate (point in time)
PC19.note: Confirms current standing only. Insufficient on its own for this question.
PC19.insufficient_alone: A tax clearance certificate confirms current standing only; on its own it cannot rule out a past period of non-compliance, which is what this question asks about.

PC19.label: Letter from another statutory body
PC19.note: The question extends to statutory requirements generally, not tax alone — for example social security or pension contributions.

FC5.label: Bank reference letter with facility conduct history
FC5.note: Primary route. Must distinguish a restructure from a write-off, since the question asks about both.
FC5.display: bank reference letter with facility conduct history

FC5.label: Credit bureau report
FC5.note: Broader coverage across lenders than a single bank's letter, where a bureau exists.

FC5.label: Statement of account or loan statement
FC5.note: Shows balances and arrears but not always the restructuring history.
FC5.display: statement of account or loan statement

FC7.label: Bank reference letter with aggregate exposure
FC7.note: Primary route. Must state indebtedness in the same currency as the threshold, or the check cannot compare the two.
FC7.display: bank reference letter with aggregate exposure

FC7.label: Credit bureau report
FC7.note: Broader coverage across lenders than a single bank's letter, where a bureau exists.

FC7.label: Statement of facilities across lenders
FC7.note: Needed where the applicant holds facilities with more than one institution.

CoI2.label: Company registry extract
CoI2.note: Primary route. Must show the entity's principal activity, or Entity_Activity_Check cannot be performed.

CoI2.label: Letter of appointment as director
CoI2.note: Confirms the appointment but not always the entity's line of business.

CoI2.label: Annual return or filing showing the directorship
CoI2.note: An alternative to a full registry extract where one is not obtainable.
CoI2.display: annual return or filing showing the directorship

CoI6.label: Company registry extract with shareholding
CoI6.note: Primary route where the interest is held directly.

CoI6.label: Share register extract
CoI6.note: Used where the registry extract does not itself list members.

CoI6.label: Trust deed or beneficial ownership declaration
CoI6.note: Needed where the interest is held through a trust or nominee arrangement rather than directly.
CoI6.display: trust deed or beneficial ownership declaration

T1.label: Board appointment letter
T1.note: Primary route. Should state an expected time commitment in hours per week.

T1.label: Employment contract
T1.note: Used for an executive appointment where the time commitment is set out in the contract rather than a separate letter.

T2.label: Board appointment letter
T2.note: Primary route. Should state explicitly whether the role carries executive responsibility.

T2.label: Job description or executive mandate letter
T2.note: An alternative where responsibility is defined in a separate mandate document.
T2.display: job description or executive mandate letter

CoL1.label: Share certificate
CoL1.note: Primary route. States the number of shares and the certificate number directly.

CoL1.label: Share register extract
CoL1.note: Used where no individual certificate has been issued.

CoL3.label: Share register extract
CoL3.note: Primary route. Names the relative directly; the relationship itself is asserted on the extract, not independently verified — see Relationship_Check.

CoL3.label: Share certificate in the relative's name
CoL3.note: An alternative where the relative holds an individual certificate.
CoL3.display: share certificate in the relative's name

CS4.label: Signed declaration, witnessed by a commissioner of oaths
CS4.note: Primary route and the stronger of the two, since it carries independent witnessing.
CS4.display: signed declaration, witnessed by a commissioner of oaths

CS4.label: Declaration countersigned by the company secretary only
CS4.note: Accepted but weaker, since the witness is not independent of the Licensee.
CS4.display: declaration countersigned by the company secretary only

cv_verification.label: Resume
cv_verification.note: Same document, US-style naming; treat identically to CV.
